content: Use Seedance 2.0 Fast instead of Seedance 2.0 to cut cost ~2× while maintaining similar results across prompts (based on 300+ tests).
tips: Use Seedance 2.0 Fast instead of Seedance 2.0 to cut cost ~2× while maintaining similar results across prompts (based on 300+ tests).
